en.about_intro: Hi, I'm Charlie Rios — Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Amsterdam.
en.about_body: I build products end-to-end: from UI architecture and design systems to APIs, infra, and production deployments. I've led frontend teams as Frontend Lead, owned features as a Product Engineer, and shipped across web, mobile, and cloud. Nowadays I'm growing into a native AI developer, building intelligent systems that reach real users.
en.about_brings: strong product sense · scalable React/TypeScript frontends · full-stack ownership · AI-native tooling
en.token_bar_desc: Native macOS menu bar app that unifies AI usage across Cursor, OpenAI, Anthropic, and more — track tokens, credits, spend, and burn rate without juggling provider dashboards. Includes Notification Center widgets, usage alerts, and privacy-first credential storage in the Keychain.
en.email_sig_desc: Schema-driven email signature builder with a guided template flow, live HTML preview, and one-click copy into Gmail. Import your profile from LinkedIn to pre-fill fields, then customize in the visual template editor — saved signature library, per-field styling, and multi-language support included.
en.github_repo_template_desc: Stack-agnostic repo shell — community docs, Dependabot, CODEOWNERS, issue & PR templates
en.ot_npm_package_template_desc: Production-ready TypeScript npm package — tsup, Vitest, ESLint, publish workflows & CodeQL
en.lizard_ui_desc: A multi-theme UI dependency for building React apps
en.responsive_panel_desc: Dev tool to visualize and test responsive breakpoints in real time
en.react_api_forge_desc: Type-safe React hook factory for API calls with loading, errors & cancellation
en.react_temporal_desc: React hooks for date & time using the JavaScript **Temporal API**
en.donate_title: 💰 You can help me by Donating
en.templates_intro: I own and maintain @open-templates — reusable GitHub starter templates with sensible defaults, init wizards, and paired fullstack packs. A few entry points:
en.dropafile_desc: Drop a file. Everyone gets it live. Ephemeral, live-session file sharing on Cloudflare Workers — spin up a room, share a link or QR code, and let connected peers download in real time. WebSocket signaling on the edge; file bytes flow peer-to-peer in the browser. No accounts, no persistent storage.
